I can't pay those two as a pair, for two reasons:

- **Watering wand:** It was already refunded, with receipt R-H314-0001 for 74.90 BRL. A unit is refunded only once, so it can't be refunded again (refund-policy/v2/remaining).
- **Hose clip:** The shop's records don't show it received back. The shop refunds only units it has received back (refund-policy/v2/return). If you send it, it has to arrive first, and I can't request anything for it now. This order's refund deadline is 2026-11-30 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window). A request made after that would be late.

The hose adapter is recorded as received back, but you've said you don't want it, so I haven't proposed anything.
